data.one_liner: Fetch public IP address and geolocation data via the ipify service.
data.what_it_does: The package calls ipify's REST endpoints to return your IPv4/IPv6 address or detailed location info for any IP. It wraps the HTTP calls in simple static methods.
use_when: You need to quickly obtain the device's public IP address.
You need basic geolocation lookup for an IP without integrating a full mapping SDK.
avoid_when: You require high‑frequency or bulk IP lookups (rate‑limited by ipify).
You need offline IP resolution or advanced location analytics.
strengths: Very small API surface – just a few async methods.
Works on all major Flutter platforms (mobile, web, desktop).
weaknesses: Limited to ipify’s free tier and features.
No built‑in caching or retry logic.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides raw HTTP requests; you can call ipify yourself without an extra wrapper.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: More feature‑rich HTTP client with interceptors and retry support, useful for complex networking needs.
